judges: Appeal, Consideration, Dismissal, Ginsburg, Light, Remand, Souter, Stevens, Vacate, Withdrawal

opinions.text:
Affirmed on appeal from D. C. D. C.

Justice Stevens, Justice Souter, Justice Ginsburg, and Justice Breyer would vacate the April 4, 1995, District Court dismissal order and remand the case for *1022further consideration in light of the United States’ withdrawal of its appeal.
